title: Design REST endpoints for user profile service

description: Verify access tokens, attach user to req, return 401 with a consistent error body on failure.

comments.body: Using RS256 so other services can verify.

title: Add refresh token rotation
description: Rotate refresh tokens on every use and revoke the family on reuse detection.

comments.body: Reuse detection works locally, need Redis for prod.

title: Set up rate limiting on public endpoints
description: Limit to 100 req/min per IP using a sliding window. Return 429 with Retry-After header.

comments.body: Starting with express-rate-limit, Redis store later.

title: Write OpenAPI documentation for orders API
description: Cover request/response schemas, error codes and examples. Publish with Swagger UI at /docs.

title: Fix N+1 query on GET /orders
description: Orders list triggers one query per customer. Use populate or a single aggregate.

comments.body: Response time dropped from 1.8s to 220ms in staging.

comments.body: Great. Add an index on customerId too.

description: Cursor-based pagination with limit and cursor params. Default limit 20, max 100.

comments.body: Cursor on createdAt + _id to keep ordering stable.
comments.author: Priya

title: Standardize error response format
description: All errors return { error: { code, message, details } }. Update the central error handler.

description: Validate body, params and query on every route. Reject unknown fields.

comments.body: Auth and tasks routes done, orders remaining.

title: Set up CI pipeline with GitHub Actions
description: Run lint, unit tests and build on every PR. Cache node_modules.

title: Write integration tests for auth endpoints
description: Cover signup, login, refresh, logout and invalid token paths using Supertest and an in-memory Mongo.

title: Add idempotency keys to POST /payments
description: Accept an Idempotency-Key header and return the stored response on repeats within 24 hours.

title: Dockerize the API service
description: Multi-stage Dockerfile, non-root user, healthcheck, and docker-compose with Mongo and Redis.

title: Add structured logging with request IDs
description: Use pino, generate X-Request-Id per request and include it in every log line and error response.

title: Implement soft delete for tasks
description: Add deletedAt field, exclude from default queries, and expose a restore endpoint.

title: Create health and readiness endpoints
description: GET /health for liveness and GET /ready that checks the database and Redis connections.

title: Add API versioning strategy
description: Prefix routes with /v1 and document the deprecation policy for older versions.

comments.body: Header versioning is overkill for us, going with URL.
comments.author: Priya

title: Investigate memory leak in file upload handler
description: Heap grows by about 40 MB per 100 uploads. Check stream handling and unclosed buffers.

comments.body: Found it: buffers retained in a closure.
comments.author: Aman

title: Add role-based access control
description: Define admin, manager and member roles. Guard routes with a permission middleware.

title: Cache GET /products with Redis
description: Cache for 60 seconds with cache invalidation on product update or delete.

title: Write Postman collection for QA team
description: Include environments, example payloads and test scripts for each endpoint.

title: Add CORS configuration per environment
description: Allow only whitelisted origins in production and permissive origins in development.

title: Implement webhook delivery with retries
description: Send events with HMAC signature, exponential backoff and a dead letter queue after 5 failures.

comments.body: Should we use BullMQ for the queue?

title: Upgrade dependencies and fix audit warnings
description: Update Express, Mongoose and dev tooling. Resolve all high severity npm audit issues.

title: Add database indexes for slow queries
description: Create compound indexes on (status, createdAt) and (assignee, dueDate) after reviewing explain plans.

title: Set up error monitoring with Sentry
description: Capture unhandled exceptions with release tags and strip sensitive fields before sending.

title: Implement file upload to S3 with presigned URLs
description: Return a presigned PUT URL, limit size to 10 MB and restrict content types.

title: Fix timezone bug in due date filtering
description: Tasks due today disappear after 6 PM IST. Normalize all dates to UTC start of day.

title: Add request size limits and sanitization
description: Cap JSON body at 100 KB, strip NoSQL operators from input, and escape regex in search.

description: Simulate 500 concurrent users on core endpoints. Target p95 under 300 ms and error rate under 1%.

comments.body: Run against staging only, not prod.

title: Write onboarding guide for new API developers
description: Cover local setup, project structure, coding standards and the PR checklist.
